title: The Temple Theme Kit's 268 design-system files are on file, each claimed by a rule, with every gap listed
detail: Intake of the new Temple Theme Kit (a theme of its own, code id temple-kit; the existing temple theme that Royal Temple wears is untouched). docs/design-systems/temple holds the rules, the inventory with hashes, tokens, copy and a baseline of 455 known gaps (75 missing targets, 380 copy sentences), which the build passes below can only shrink. The four faces are the ones already self-hosted under app/fonts/temple; the 24 textures and 10 glyphs differ from the old theme's and ship under public/sites/temple-kit. scripts/design-system.test.ts now reads each theme's token block from a table instead of assuming Nocturne's.

verify.evidence: All 268 files are claimed; the baseline lists the rest.
